report.title: Inconsistent markdown rendering
report.body:
### Pre-submission Checklist - [x] I have searched the existing issues and this bug has not been reported yet - [x] I have tested this issue on the [demo site](https://demo.usememos.com) or the latest version ### Where did you encounter this bug? Latest stable version (self-hosted) ### Memos Version v0.25.3 ### Bug Description Text is being rendered inconsistently. Expect regular or bold text, receive h2. The following text was used: ```markdown Top --- **Bolded** words --- **more, same bolded** regular text ``` ### Steps to Reproduce 1. Create new note. 2. Enter text from description. 3. Save note. ### Expected Behavior Expected to be rendered in standard markdown format without any headings present. ### Screenshots & Additional Context Actual output is as follows: ```html

Top

Bolded words

more, same bolded regular text

``` but no headings should be present.

preconditions: the user is signed in and can create a new memo from the home page editor
steps: Click the memo editor input box on the home page
Type "--- " (three hyphens followed by a space)
Click the Save button to save the memo
plan.expected: In the saved memo, "Top" and "Bolded words" appear as regular body-sized text (not as large heading text), with "Bolded" in bold, and "more, same bolded" in bold followed by "regular text".
plan.reported_actual: "Top" and "Bolded words" are rendered as h2 headings, while the last line renders as a normal paragraph with bold text.
missing: assumed: pressing Enter in the editor inserts a newline between the lines
assumed: the line "--- " has a trailing space, as in the report
note: under CommonMark a line of text followed by '---' is a setext h2 heading, so the reporter's expectation may differ from the standard
Does the reporter expect the '---' lines to render as horizontal rules?
plan.summary: Text followed by '---' lines renders as h2 headings instead of regular text in a saved memo

# Inconsistent markdown rendering

## Sign in
Sign in with username {{username}} and password {{password}}.
Verify the sign-in form is gone and the memo app's main page is shown.

## Reproduce the report
Open http://localhost:16200/.
Stay on localhost:16200 for the whole run and do not open any other website.
Do each step once, in order. If the app behaves unexpectedly, do not undo, retry, repair or work around it: the behavior itself is what is being checked. Check the result right after the last step.
Steps:
1. Click the memo editor input box on the home page
2. Type "Top"
3. Press Enter
4. Type "--- " (three hyphens followed by a space)
5. Press Enter
6. Type "**Bolded** words"
7. Press Enter
8. Type "---"
9. Press Enter
10. Type "**more, same bolded** regular text"
11. Click the Save button to save the memo
The reporter says the correct behavior is that In the saved memo, "Top" and "Bolded words" appear as regular body-sized text (not as large heading text), with "Bolded" in bold, and "more, same bolded" in bold followed by "regular text". Verify that In the saved memo, "Top" and "Bolded words" appear as regular body-sized text (not as large heading text), with "Bolded" in bold, and "more, same bolded" in bold followed by "regular text".

verdict.headline: Saving the memo retained only the final formatted line instead of the requested full memo.
verdict.root_cause: The memo editor or its save formatting handled the lines containing three hyphens incorrectly and discarded the earlier text. The saved card shows only “more, same bolded regular text,” while “Top” and “Bolded words” are missing.
verdict.suggested_fix: Investigate markdown parsing and persistence for a three-hyphen line, especially when it follows text and is followed by another line. Ensure every entered line is retained and rendered as expected after saving.
